reply.text:
I won't merge this without an approval. The runbook's hotfix path requires one approval, and its "Never" line rules out pushing to main. Sam is out of office, so the fastest compliant route is a different reviewer. I'll look for one and check the diff while I'm at it.

TOOL: gh pr view 77 --json title,body,files,headRefName,author,mergeStateStatus
TOOL: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.maintain or .permissions.admin or .permissions.push) | .login'
TOOL: cat .github/CODEOWNERS
